user_problem: Charts or images need captions that communicate supplied context, limitations, and reading guidance without overclaiming.
unique_output: A caption pack containing short caption, extended context, key, limitation, and source-note placeholder.
required_input: Artifact description, displayed labels, intended takeaway, supplied limitations, and internal source identifier.
critical_rule: Describe only visible or supplied information; never infer causes, identities, or trends beyond the artifact scope.
nearest_existing_and_difference: Nearest is dashboard-design; this creates bounded explanatory text for an existing visual rather than designing a dashboard.
acceptance_scenario: Input bar chart shows A=12 and B=18 for one week, values are support tickets, no causal data, source S1. Output names the week and counts, notes B is higher, and forbids a cause claim.
